Brrr, it's freezing! I-I've never[XENO:n ]
been this cold before! Brrrr![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]It is to be expected. This climate is as different to your[XENO:n ]
home as it gets. It only snows this high up on the Giant God.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
Riki hates cold places-mo~.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
This can't be nice for Riki. He's from Makna.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]A little further down is Sword Valley, right?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Yes. But before then I must[XENO:n ]
show you something.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]

Do you not see? That tall formation that[XENO:n ]
looks like a tower. Ruins, to be precise.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
See it-mo! Taller than Frontier Village's tree-mo![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
We can rest there. I'll explain everything then.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
